UPDATE FCLTY_MANAGE A SET A.FCLTYMANAGE_CHCKSTTUS = (SELECT CASE WHEN C.CMMNTY_CHCKSTTUS IN ('정상','점검완료') THEN '점검완료' ELSE C.CMMNTY_CHCKSTTUS END FROM CMMNTY C WHERE C.CMMNTY_SN = A.CMMNTY_SN)
WHERE A.CMMNTY_SN = #{cmmntySn} AND A.FCLTY_MANAGE_SN=( SELECT MAX(B.FCLTY_MANAGE_SN) FROM FCLTY_MANAGE B WHERE A.CMMNTY_SN = B.CMMNTY_SN )

UPDATE FCLTY_MANAGE A SET A.FCLTYMANAGE_CHCKSTTUS = ( SELECT B.CMMNTY_CHCKSTTUS FROM CMMNTY B WHERE B.CMMNTY_SN = A.CMMNTY_SN ) WHERE( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FCLTY_MANAGE C WHERE C.CMMNTY_SN = A.CMMNTY_SN ) < 2 AND A.CMMNTY_SN = #{cmmntySn}
